title: The National Sports Club of Assam (Taking-Over Management) 1978 (Act No.9 of 1978)
full_text: The National Sports Club of Assam (Taking-Over Management) 1978 (Act No.9 of 1978) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19789 Act Number: 9 Enactment Date: 1978-08-09 Act Year: 1978 Short Title: The National Sports Club of Assam (Taking-Over Management) 1978 (Act No.9 of 1978) Long Title: An Act to provide for the taking-over of the management of the National Sports Club of Assam within the State of Meghalaya from the present Executive Committee and other committees of the Club and from the holders of offices of the Club for a limited period in the public interest and in order to secure the proper management of the Club and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Law Department Department: Law Department Enforcement Date: 1978-06-02 Type: STATE Location: Meghalaya TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title and commencement Section 2. Definitions Section 3. Transfer or the management of the Club to and vesting thereof in the State Government. Section 4. Management of and control over the Club and its affairs. Section 5. Preparation and submission of Statements and penalty for non- compliance. Section 6. Delivery of Books of Accounts, Registers and properties, etc, and penalty for non- compliance. Section 7. Creation of the Sports Fund. Section 8. Relinquishment of management of the Club. Section 9. Protection of action taken under the Act. Section 10. Power to make rules. Section 11. Over-riding effect of the Act. Section 12. Repeal of Ordinance 5 of 1973.
